lines.speaker: Your boss
lines.text: Chief Executive's back from that retreat. Goats, I think. Apparently we're not behind any more. We're exercising strategic patience.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Is that different from being behind?

lines.speaker: Your boss
lines.text: It's more expensive. Don't go spreading it about, nobody on our floor's heard it yet. Same again?
Your boss buys a round and claims it as stakeholder engagement. You are the stakeholder.
You get to the front early. The only other person here is from Facilities, testing the chairs.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: Nobody's early. Mind that one, it's been reported.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: New north star, they tell me. I've been asked to keep the fire exit clear of it.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: You don't get there, as I understand it. You just face it.

title: A demonstration, in the fourth-floor corridor

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: Love the lanyard. So right now finance has its numbers, you have yours, and it all ends in a meeting. Am I close?

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: With us, that's gone. You have a single source of truth.

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: Yours. While I'm talking to you.
